北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感-1℃，风力不小，穿暖和再出门哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -1℃ with strong wind, bundle up before heading out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪北风四级，体感仅2℃，注意防风保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has a strong north wind and feels like 2℃, remember to stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天气晴朗，风力不大，仍需注意添衣保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny with light wind, but still remember to dress warmly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州西北风四级，体感13℃，微凉，记得添衣。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 13℃ with a strong northwest wind, a bit chilly, add a layer.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗微风，体感13℃，早晚温差大，别着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny with a light breeze, feels like 13℃. Mind the day-night temperature difference.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感只有2℃，东北风力大，务必多穿衣哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like only 2℃ with strong northeast wind, please dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天气晴朗，体感4℃，外出注意保暖，多喝水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 4℃. Stay warm and hydrated when out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗体感8℃，微风和煦，适宜外出散步哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels like 8℃ with a gentle breeze, perfect for a stroll.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云体感9℃，虽然微暖，早晚温差仍大。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 9℃, it's mild but mind the day-night temperature difference.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感4℃，天气较干燥，注意保暖和补水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 4℃, and it's quite dry. Remember to stay warm and hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感9℃，湿度适中，注意适时增减衣物。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 9℃ with moderate humidity, dress appropriately.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-19℃！超级冷，请务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -19℃! Extremely cold, please bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-10℃，寒意十足，出门多穿几层哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -10℃, quite chilly, wear extra layers when going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾体感3℃，湿度较大，出行请注意安全。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is foggy and feels like 3℃ with high humidity, please travel safely.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门东风五级，体感6℃，风力较大，注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has a strong east wind and feels like 6℃, take care in the wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感-1℃，风力不小，出门记得戴好帽子手套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -1℃ with strong wind, remember to wear a hat and gloves.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感-4℃，西南风四级，穿厚点，别着凉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -4℃ with a strong southwest wind, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
